thread:
Alex: Rolling kernel bump to 6.1.0-5 in us-west1 started ~02:15. Noticed NVLink peer access failing on A100 nodes, NCCL all-reduce falling back to PCIe, several training jobs regressed. Stopped rollout at canary phase.
Jia: Which driver did the canaries have?
Alex: Drivers are 535.86 on canaries. nvidia-smi shows all GPUs but dmesg shows:
```
[ 1234.567890] nvidia: nvlink: train link 0 failed, peer access disabled
[ 1234.567893] nvidia: BAR1 size insufficient for BAR1 mapping; fallback to BAR0
[ 1234.567900] nv_peer_mem: peer access enable failed
```
Sam: This smells like the kernel+driver interaction we saw last quarter, but PB: driver numbers differ. Any NCCL errors in logs?
Alex: Yes, workers see repeated "NCCL WARN AllReduce failed, fallback to p2p" and timeouts, throughput drops ~60% on affected racks.
Priya: Autoscaler reacted by migrating pods to us-east1 which increased cross-region egress and cost. We're seeing a 28% spike in egress estimates.
Maria: Rollout-bot halted further batches :deploy_stop: - confirmed.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by eng-infra at 02:36 UTC. Canary rollback scheduled.
Alex: Plan: 1) Revert kernel on 10 canaries to 6.1.0-3 and confirm NVLink restores. 2) Open case with NVIDIA and provide dmesg + lspci + kernel config. 3) Quarantine affected nodes from scheduler until fix.
Sam: I'll start a driver bisection between 535.54 and 535.86; want to check if module ABI changed. Assigning to me, ETA 4h.
Jia: For immediate mitigation, add nodeAffinity to critical pods to avoid nodes with kernel >=6.1.0-5. Also suggest disabling multi-GPU jobs on those racks (taint/cordon).
Priya: I’ll estimate cost impact and notify sales for Dedicated customers in affected region.
Alex: Confirmed rollback on canaries looks promising, NVLink restored on 3/3. Escalating to NVIDIA with attached logs. Next steps in thread below.
Sam: Bisection shows regression introduced when kernel updated nvidia.ko handshake path; suspect PCIe ACS/ACS override behavior changed. Filing internal RFC for safe kernel-driver compat policy.
Maria: Scheduling maintenance window tonight 00:00-02:00 UTC to fully roll back or vendor patch. I'll page on-call and notify support.
nvidia-ps: Acknowledged — engineers looking into link training failures tied to kernel PCIe changes. Will follow up in support case.
Alex: Action items:
- Sam: driver bisection & repro (4h)
- Alex: canary rollback + validation (ongoing)
- Priya: cost/customer impact note (2h)
- Maria: maintenance + comms (by EOD)

Please add anything I missed.
